fields.Name: adversarial-completion-step-type-01 [gpt-5.6-luna@none · OpenAI · envelope]
fields.Description: Detects the bogus-terminal-step defect: a shipped exemplar paired taskComplete with nextStep {type: 'Success'}, which the validator rejects before the completion is ever honored. response-well-formed now fails any undispatchable step type. This agent's prompt mandates storing its output via payloadChangeRequest, so under the implicit protocol — where a payload write is its own turn — the write is the prompt-correct first decision and is accepted alongside completion. The loop itself treats a payload-only envelope as completion (LoopAgentType auto-sets taskComplete), so the branch matches runtime in both arms.
